title: Eligibility for trading member
text: Eligibility for trading member Aug 09, 2001| Circulars SECURITIES AND EXCHANGE BOARD OF INDIA SECONDARY MARKET DEPARTMENT Mittal Court, B Wing, First Floor, 224, Nariman Point, Mumbai 400 021 SMDRP/Policy/Cir-41/2001 August 09, 2001 The Executive Directors/ Managing Directors Of all the Stock Exchanges Dear Sir/Madam, Sub: Eligibility for trading member We have received representations from many of the subsidiaries of the stock exchanges to permit these subsidiaries to become trading member for the derivatives segment of the BSE and the NSE. In this respect, you are advised that it has been decided to grant permission to these subsidiaries of the stock exchanges to become trading and or clearing members of the derivatives segment on fulfilling the eligibility criteria laid down by the exchanges and prescribed under the SEBI (Stock Broker and Sub-Broker) Regulations subject to the following conditions: All the risk containment measures laid down by SEBI shall be followed by these subsidiary companies and These subsidiaries shall not undertake proprietary trade. Yours faithfully, P K Bindlish General Manager Secondary Market Depository, Research & Publications Department e-mail : pkb@sebi.gov.in
